definitions.explanation: The act of taking someone else's property without permission. Used as the noun form of the verb {盗|ぬす}む (to steal).

examples.japanese: {盗|ぬす}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧だ。
{盗|ぬす}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{捕|つか}まった→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧。
examples.english: The man who committed the theft was caught.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{盗|ぬす}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦{叱|しか}られた→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧。
examples.english: I stole something as a child and was severely scolded by my parents.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{盗|ぬす}む→盗む：01166_nusumu⟧ (to steal). Refers to the act of stealing itself rather than the stolen goods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盗|ぬす}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ — to commit theft
- {盗|ぬす}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ — to break in to steal
- {盗|ぬす}み{聞|ぎ}き — eavesdropping
- {盗|ぬす}み{見|み} — peeping, peeking
- {盗|ぬす}み{食|ぐ}い — sneaking food, eating on the sly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{窃盗|せっとう}→窃盗：15280_settou⟧ — theft (legal/formal term used in criminal law)
- ⟦{万引|まんび}き→万引き：16838_manbiki⟧ — shoplifting (specifically from stores)
